messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
Here’s a concise overview of key Texas traffic laws and regulations: | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• Rural interstate highways: 75 mph (or 70 mph if posted).
• Urban interstate highways: 65 mph.
• School zones: 20 mph during school hours (unless posted otherwise). | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Back‑to‑front seats are required for children under 2. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, mandatory alcohol‑education programs, and possible jail time. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (except for emergency calls).
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles on the right have priority.
• Pedestrians always have priority at crosswalks. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light: stop; green light: proceed; yellow light: prepare to stop.
• Stop signs require a full stop before proceeding. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Passing on the right is prohibited unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 15 ft of a fire hydrant.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited unless marked otherwise. | | **School Bus Laws** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children. | | **Vehicle Equipment** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Tires must have adequate tread depth (minimum 2 mm). | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 total bodily injury, $25,000 property damage. | ### How to Find Specific Statutes - **Texas Transportation Code** – Sections 545.001–545.999 cover most traffic laws. - **Texas Administrative Code** – Provides regulations and enforcement guidelines. - **Official Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Offers driver handbooks and updates. If you need more detailed legal text or recent amendments, let me know!
